اجترمن (form VIII)

# اُجْتُرِمْنَ (ujturimna) /ud͡ʒ.tu.rim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# اِجْتَرِمْنَ (ijtarimna) /id͡ʒ.ta.rim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
